require "/home/user/workspace/repo/bench/experiments/ar_request_sites"

module F2EventProgram
  PINS = {
    "app/models/event_summary.rb" => "d8274861e2af6c2dd18c5eebb675f56fe4e65623da2c209424dcc050c74ee28d",
    "app/models/event.rb" => "4f0edbea62fdbbdfa29baef9b5284bc740d45eab8c63a2bf15305a331ac8c218"
  }.freeze
  class << self
    def install(app)
      raise "specimen source changed" unless PINS.all? { |path, sha| Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(app, path)).hexdigest == sha }
      ready = ->(model) do
        @model = model
        @original = model.instance_method(:main_summary)
        raise "unexpected summary body" unless @original.source_location == [File.join(app, "app/models/event_summary.rb"), 14]
        model.prepend(Summary)
      end
      if (model = Lowrail.loaded_constant("EventSummary"))
        ready.call(model)
      else
        Rails.autoloaders.main.on_load("EventSummary") { |_, model| ready.call(model) }
      end
    end

    def rows(owner)
      return unless ARRequestSites.enabled
      return unless @model.instance_method(:main_summary).super_method == @original
      unless @site
        event = Lowrail.loaded_constant("Event")
        return unless event
        @site = ARRequestSites::Site.new("summary_events", [@model], :events, event, 1,
          %i[chronologically non_boosts]) do |id|
          key = @model.reflect_on_association(:events).foreign_key
          event.where(key => id).chronologically.non_boosts
        end
        holder = ActiveRecord::QueryMethods::WhereChain
        @not = [holder.instance_method(:not), holder.public_method_defined?(:not)]
      end
      return unless ActiveRecord::QueryMethods::WhereChain.instance_method(:not) == @not[0] &&
        ActiveRecord::QueryMethods::WhereChain.public_method_defined?(:not) == @not[1] && @site.eligible?(owner)
      @site.load(owner, [owner.id]) { owner.events.non_boosts }
    end
  end

  module Summary
    private
    def main_summary
      rows = F2EventProgram.rows(self)
      return super unless rows
      rows.map { |event| summarize(event) }.join(" ")
    end
  end
end

require "/tmp/lowrail-f2/event_program"

module F2FallbackProbe
  OBSERVATIONS = []
  def eligible?(owner)
    accepted = super
    return accepted unless @name == "summary_events" && !accepted
    association = owner.association(@association)
    cached = association.instance_variable_get(:@association_scope)
    begin
      association.instance_variable_set(:@association_scope, nil)
      without_cache = super
    ensure
      association.instance_variable_set(:@association_scope, cached)
    end
    OBSERVATIONS << {cached_scope: !cached.nil?, loaded: association.loaded?,
      accepted_with_only_scope_cache_temporarily_removed: without_cache}
    accepted
  end
end
